items.fd: Priority Assets and Purge the Foe
items.name: Guardians of the Throne
items.gist: All-rounder: Sustained Hits 1 or Lethal Hits in melee for every unit.

rule.t: In the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to fight, its melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] (choose one).

strats: A friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit that is not readied becomes readied. Same unit only once per battle round.
After an advance move: ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]; the advance does not prevent declaring a charge.
INFANTRY/MOUNTED: an engaged enemy model that does not target your unit with all its attacks has -1 to hit and -1 to wound.
Ranged attacks: re-roll one hit roll, one wound roll, one damage roll.
Attacks that target your unit (not Custodian Wardens) have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
Enemy ends a move within 8" of an unengaged TRUSTED SENTINEL: that unit makes a normal move up to D3+3".

items.name: Shadowkeepers
items.gist: Melee objective defence and pressure on enemy morale.

rule.t: ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) within range of an objective: melee attacks targeting it with S greater than its T have -1 to wound.

ka.t: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit: it makes a battle-shock roll with -1. Same enemy unit only once per phase.

strats: INFANTRY selected to fight: melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: CHARACTER/MONSTER].
Enemy ends a fall-back move: your unengaged INFANTRY within 6" declares a charge (only against units that fell back and are within max distance).
After an enemy unit has fought: your unit within an objective and eligible to fight has Fights First and must be your next unit selected to fight.

items.name: Solar Watch
items.gist: Mobility: fall back without losing the charge, +2" Move.

rule.t: When a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit makes a fall-back move, it can still be eligible to charge.

strats: Until end of turn, ignore modifiers to M, advance rolls and charge rolls.
Fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
Unengaged unit: one visible enemy within 12" has -1 to its charge rolls when it declares a charge.

items.name: Aquilan Shield
items.gist: Shooting: +6" range and objective protection against high-Strength shots.

rule.t: ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) within range of an objective: ranged attacks targeting it with S greater than its T have -1 to wound.

ka.t: Your unit’s ranged attacks have +6" R.

strats: Fall-back move does not prevent shooting or declaring a charge.
Ranged attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" have +1 S.
Enemy ends a fall-back move: your INFANTRY that was engaged with it shoots (normal shooting), only that enemy unit.

items.name: Dread Host
items.gist: Charging: re-roll charge rolls, shorter pile-ins for the opponent.

rule.t: Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units can re-roll charge rolls.

ka.t: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a pile-in/consolidation move, -2" from that move.

strats: Your unit’s pile-in move can be up to D3+3".
After an ingress move: until your next turn, attacks targeting your unit have -1 to hit and it cannot be targeted by snap shooting.
After an advance move: it does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

items.name: Emissaries Imperatus
items.gist: Fights First for everyone, objectives and actions.

rule.t: Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units have Fights First.

ka.t: Until end of turn, advance/fall-back moves do not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

strats: Your unit’s melee attacks can ignore modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls.
Melee attacks that target a unit with a T greater than your unit’s T have +1 to wound.
Unengaged unit within 6" of an enemy unit declares a charge (charge roll above 6 becomes 6; targets only within 6").

items.name: Emperor’s Chosen
items.gist: Re-roll one hit and one wound for any unit that attacks.

rule.t: When a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to attack, its attacks can re-roll one hit roll and one wound roll.

ka.t: Select one enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE engaged with your unit, roll D6: 1-2 = 1 mortal wound, 3-5 = D3, 6 = 3 mortal wounds.

strats: A friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit that is not readied becomes readied. Once per unit per battle round.
Attacks that target your unit (not Custodian Wardens) have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
Unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) controlling an objective: that objective is secured.

items.name: Auric Champions
items.gist: Big-game hunting: Characters get +1 to wound against the chosen target.

rule.t: In your Command phase, select one enemy unit to be a dreadful foe until your next Command phase. ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER attacks against it have +1 to wound.

strats: After a CHARACTER used a (once per battle, per unit) datasheet ability: use it one additional time, not in the same phase. Once per battle per model.
When a model is destroyed (unit not yet selected to fight): roll D6 (+1 if CHARACTER); on 3+ it stays on the battlefield until the unit has fought.

items.name: Honoured Companions
items.gist: Trusted Sentinel: re-roll wound rolls of 1 on objectives.

rule.t: TRUSTED SENTINEL unit within range of an objective: its attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

strats: TRUSTED SENTINEL consolidation: may use the objective consolidation mode regardless of its Before Moving restrictions.
TRUSTED SENTINEL below starting strength: melee attacks (not CHARACTER models) have +2 A.
Enemy ends a move within 8" of an unengaged TRUSTED SENTINEL: normal move up to D3+3".

items.name: Lions of the Emperor
items.gist: Terminators: back to strategic reserves, aggressive ingress.

rule.t: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, an unengaged ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit can be placed in strategic reserves.

strats: TERMINATOR unit targeted: attacks that target it have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.
TERMINATOR unit with 2+ models splits into separate one-model units.
TERMINATOR unit that made an ingress move this turn: +2 to charge rolls.

items.name: Might of the Moritoi
items.gist: Dreadnoughts that get more dangerous when wounded.

rule.t: DREADNOUGHT at starting strength: +2 OC. Below starting strength: re-roll hit rolls of 1. Below half-strength: re-roll hit and wound rolls of 1.

strats: Unit gains an aura: friendly DREADNOUGHT within 6" can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
After an advance move: ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]; the advance does not prevent a charge.

items.name: Grav-Assault Force
items.gist: Grav-Assault vehicles: 4+ invulnerable save against shooting.

rule.t: Friendly GRAV-ASSAULT units have 4+ InSv against ranged attacks.

strats: GRAV-ASSAULT unit within range of an objective is destroyed: that objective can become secured (conditions apply).
Your unit can ignore modifiers to BS and hit rolls.

items.name: Null Maiden Vigil
items.gist: Anathema Psykana: can be Warlord, Prosecutors become Battleline.

rule.t: You can select a friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA CHARACTER as your WARLORD. Friendly PROSECUTOR SQUAD units have BATTLELINE. Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units have Creeping Dread (aura): enemy PSYKER/below-starting-strength units within 12" take battle-shock with -1.

strats: VIGILATOR SQUAD: attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS].
After a PROSECUTOR SQUAD shot: one enemy unit hit becomes prosecuted (+1 AP against it).
WITCHSEEKER SQUAD: [TORRENT] attacks have +1 A, or +2 A against PSYKER/battle-shocked units.
